newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen says over 2,000 candidates running in poll.
newsitem.headline: Yemen says over 2,000 candidates running in poll.

text.p: Some 2,306 candidates will run for 301 parliamentary seats in Yemen's upcoming elections, an official of Yemen's Supreme Elections Committee said on Tuesday.
Election officials had initially expected about 5,000 candidates to run for office in the April 27 poll, the poor Arab state's first elections since a civil war in 1994.
"Some 1,498 candidates...have withdrawn their candidacy," he told Reuters.
Four parties have said they would boycott the elections because of alleged irregularities. Candidates from 12 parties and many independents remain in the running.
According to the election law, candidates could only withdraw from the poll until April 20.
